r-code user prompts and final assistant replies by conversation turn in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
`@geecraft23/dsh-turn-colors` adds subtle background colors to conversations in DeepSeek Harness Web
. A user message and its final Assistant reply share one color; the next Turn uses another. System p
rompts, reasoning, tools, and message actions stay unchanged.
Requires Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` and pnpm. The commands use the current DSH alpha release;
Add the plugin to the `web` Profile once:
The plugin is saved in the `web` Profile, so the launch command does not need the package name again
